verdicts.reason: Both are the centred stack shrunk into a wide banner instead of a left-to-right layout. That leaves large empty side areas while the headline, subline and button are squeezed between the top and bottom edges, and the CTA sits very close to the bottom. A's headline is slightly smaller, so the subline has a little room to breathe. B's larger headline pushes 'Now in four flavours.' right up against the line above it, the top margin is thinner, and the vertical spacing is crowded and uneven.
